tenderSchedule.title: Supply, installation, Testing & Commissioning of Turbine Oil Purification System for Right Bank Units at Bhadra Generating Station
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of 01 no. of Continuous flow rate min 20LPM Portable oil filter machine, with operating pressure of of 0.5-1.5kg/sq.cm.Moisture in oil should be less than 500ppm.Design to operate up to 60 DEG CEL.Motor should be heavy duty for run at 24/7hrs.Machine should be suitable for filtration of mineral-based oil up to 320CST.Safety switch for Pressure increases above 1.5kg/cm2.Supply of suction and discharge hoses of 15mtrs each.Supply of 04 nos of Filter elements as a spare.The offered system should be able to clean the oil to NAS5 or better and the moisture level should be 500 ppm or better. This parameter should be demonstrated during installation.De-sludging/De-watering high vacuum unit.Magnetic Strainer with mechanical filter.Movable Type.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer O AND M Office SVP Bhadra

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted and tender is of two cover system.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.eproc.karnataka.gov.in

orrigendum/ modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e- Procurement, contact the office of the Executive Engineer (O&M)Bhadra, Bhadra Generating Station, KPCL, B.R.Project,577115, Bhadravathi - Tq, Shimoga - Dist, Karnataka, Mob No.:9449598814.
Section I, II, III, Instruction to bidders, Form of Bid, and Self declaration are part of the Tender document.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.

Prices for each item specified in work estimate shall be uploaded in the e-portal itself. Prices will be evaluated based on the rates quoted in the e-portal i.e., the sum total price of items forming the total bid amount. Note: Rates per unit quoted shall be FOR destination basis and exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the undersigned.
The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the final requirement at the time of placing the work order.

Bidders are advised to visit the work site at Bhadra Generating Station before bidding to obtain the hands on information if required about the quantum of work and supply involved from the concerned division head. Further, post tender correspondences regarding technical specification, scope of work and supply involved will not be entertained and it is the responsibility of the bidders to get any queries cleared before bidding for subject work.

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.
